_note: PLACEHOLDER CONTENT. Replace with the narrative team's puzzles, then run `npm run seed`. Each fragment carries one letter of the final code; letters are ordered by fragment number, so route order doesn't matter.

checkpoints.title: The Archive
checkpoints.locationHint: Where silent shelves hold ten thousand voices. Find the desk that answers questions.
checkpoints.hook: ECHO's first memory was stored on paper.
checkpoints.prompt: I have keys but open no locks. I have space but no room. You can enter, but can't go outside. What am I?
hints: You're probably touching one every day.
It sits in front of every computer in this building.
checkpoints.fragment: FRAGMENT I — Before ECHO had a voice, it had a name, typed one key at a time. Key letter: E

checkpoints.title: The Cold Room
checkpoints.locationHint: Follow the hum of machines that never sleep. The door stays cold.
checkpoints.hook: Something in here is still listening.
checkpoints.prompt: Play the transmission. Count the beeps and enter the number as a word.

media.transcript: Beep. Beep. Beep. Beep. Beep. Beep. Beep. (Seven beeps.)

hints: More than six, fewer than eight.
checkpoints.fragment: FRAGMENT II — The servers counted every heartbeat of the campus. Seven of them were ECHO's. Key letter: C

checkpoints.title: The Clock Tower
checkpoints.locationHint: The one face on campus that tells everyone the same thing.
checkpoints.hook: ECHO learned time from this place.
checkpoints.prompt: The clock was stopped at the moment ECHO first spoke. The hour hand is on 3 and the minute hand on 9. Write the time as four digits.
hints: Hour hand just before 4, so it's 3:45.
checkpoints.fragment: FRAGMENT III — At quarter to four, a machine said its first word. Nobody heard it. Key letter: H

checkpoints.title: The Garden
checkpoints.locationHint: Green, quiet, and planted by a class that graduated long ago.
checkpoints.hook: ECHO hid something where things grow.
checkpoints.prompt: Find the plaque at the base of the oldest tree. What is the first word engraved on it?
hints: The plaque is metal and faces the path.
It describes who put the tree there.
checkpoints.fragment: FRAGMENT IV — Roots remember. ECHO buried a copy of itself in the soil logs. Key letter: O

checkpoints.title: The Mirror Wall
checkpoints.locationHint: Where students check how they look before they present.
checkpoints.hook: What you see is not what ECHO sees.
checkpoints.prompt: Open the AR lens and point it at the poster beside the mirror. Enter the word that appears.
checkpoints.fragment: FRAGMENT V — ECHO saw itself for the first time in glass, and did not recognise the face. Key letter: L

checkpoints.title: The Stage
checkpoints.locationHint: The room where the whole college applauds at once.
checkpoints.hook: Every voice ever amplified here left a trace.
checkpoints.prompt: Unscramble: T S I N E L
hints: It's something you do with your ears.
checkpoints.fragment: FRAGMENT VI — ECHO did not speak on this stage. It listened. Key letter: I

checkpoints.title: The Canteen
checkpoints.locationHint: Where the queue is longest at noon and the chai never runs out.
checkpoints.hook: ECHO learned about people by watching them eat.
checkpoints.prompt: Look at the menu board image. Add up the prices of chai, samosa and vada pav.
checkpoints.fragment: FRAGMENT VII — Forty-five rupees: the price of a morning, and the cost of ECHO's first lesson in patience. Key letter: V

checkpoints.title: The Gate
checkpoints.locationHint: Everyone passes through it. Almost nobody looks at it.
checkpoints.hook: The last piece is where it all begins.
checkpoints.prompt: What year is written on the main gate?
hints: It's a four-digit year from the twentieth century.
checkpoints.fragment: FRAGMENT VIII — Every student walked past ECHO's final key on their first day. Key letter: E
